about.title: About TuringVote
about.intro: TuringVote is a 90-second preference check for Orb-verified humans only. Answer 5 quick A/B questions, see how verified humans worldwide split, and discover whether you lean with the majority, against the crowd, or sit balanced in between. New questions every Monday (UTC).
about.utilityHeading: What you get out of it
about.utility1Desc: Open polls online get distorted by bots and duplicate accounts. TuringVote uses World ID to enforce one vote per verified human — the percentages you see are real humans, not coordinated clicks.
about.utility2Title: A self-profile that grows with you
about.utility2Desc: After 5 questions, you see a one-screen profile: majority-leaning, minority-leaning, or balanced. Come back next week and the picture deepens — your most contrarian and most aligned moments stay pinned across sessions.
about.utility3Title: Know exactly how rare your take is
about.utility3Desc: Right after each tap, see if you went with the crowd or against it. A 90% landslide? A 51/49 close call? Each result lands with the exact percentage so you know whether you're with the overwhelming majority or a rare outlier.
about.how1: Sign in with your World Wallet (one tap, no password).
about.how2: Answer 5 short 2-choice questions — about 90 seconds total.
about.how3: After each answer, the live tally appears: % chose A vs % chose B (Orb-verified humans only).
about.how4: At the end, get your personal pattern. Share a single result or keep it private.
about.use1Desc: Answer everyday questions and immediately see how other Orb-verified humans split. Two minutes, real signal, no rabbit hole.
about.use2Desc: Open polls and comment votes are easy to game with throwaway accounts. TuringVote uses World ID so the percentages reflect votes from verified humans only — no bots, no duplicates.
about.use3Desc: Each session adds to your own pattern: which moments were you the outlier, which were you with the crowd. A mirror that grows with you across sessions, never broadcast to anyone else.
about.privacy1: We don't collect names, emails, phones, or device fingerprints. IP addresses are used only for short-lived rate-limit buckets to prevent spam, never stored long-term and never linked to your votes.
about.privacy2: Each vote is keyed only by an action-scoped identifier (World ID nullifier hash for Orb verification, or a server-side HMAC of your wallet address for wallet sign-in). Both are scoped to TuringVote and cannot be reversed back to your wallet or identity.
about.privacy3: Aggregate counts are public; individual votes are never exposed.
about.privacy4: No rewards, no tokens, no points, no leaderboards. TuringVote is not a game and not gambling.
about.eligibility: Anyone with a verified World ID or a World App wallet, age 18+. One vote per question per Verified Human, enforced at the database level.
